<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Release the next highest-priority work unit on a process path"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/paths/{pathId}/work-releases"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Applies the release policy to a process path's `WorkPool` — the ReleaseNextWork use case. Admits the pending work unit with the earliest (most urgent) CPT, transitioning it Pending → Released. This is continuous, priority-ordered admission (waveless), not a batch/wave release. A release-fed pool enforces its WIP limit as a hard invariant: releasing past the limit fails with `409`. Publishes `WorkReleased`, which downstream fulfillment-execution consumes to create a Task. This is a collection-level command on the path's work pool (not scoped to a single work unit id, since the caller does not choose which unit is released — the priority policy does), analogous in REST terms to a resource-scoped bulk action.

  parameters={[{"name":"Idempotency-Key","in":"header","required":true,"description":"Caller-supplied key that makes a retried POST safe (ADR-0022, ADR-0047). 1-128 printable ASCII characters; **clients must always send one** (missing: `400 idempotency-key-required`; malformed: `400 idempotency-key-invalid`). Generate a fresh UUID per logical submit and reuse it only to retry that same request. The key is global: reusing it with a different method, path or body is `409 idempotency-key-reused`. A replayed answer carries `Idempotency-Replayed: true`.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128},"example":"6f1c9a52-8f6e-4a0b-9d44-2c1b0f7a3e55"},{"name":"pathId","in":"path","required":true,"description":"The process path's identifier — a named station that owns a queue (unit-in → unit-out), e.g. a pick zone or pack line. Must belong to a process-path family declared in this deployment's process-path catalogue (ADR-0012; today the fleet's sortable-fc topology declares the pick/pack/rebin/slam families, each optionally carrying a \"-\"-delimited station/zone suffix, e.g. pick-a or pack-station-1). The write endpoints (receiveChargeForecast, commitShiftPlan, enqueueWorkUnit) reject ids outside the declared families with `400 unknown-path-id`; read endpoints surface a missing pool/projection as `404` instead.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"pattern":"^(pick|pack|rebin|slam)(-.*)?$"},"example":"pick-a"}]}
